tei:div.tei:p: 227) phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi rtsa bsnyen dmigs rim mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ nam mkha'i gar khyab pha ma sems can rnams// rgyal ba kun gyi gsang 'dzin mthu stobs bdag /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin dbang bsgrub par bya/ om̐ swa bha wa shu ddha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shu dhonyahaṃ/ sngags kyi nus pa ma dag snod bcud sbyang*// 'khor 'das ma lus gdod nas dag pa yi// stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs padma dang*// nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la rang rig 'di// hūm̐ yig mthing nag 'od du 'bar bar gyur// 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal ba thams cad mchod// mar 'phros rgyal ba kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pa yis// hūm̐ de phyag na rdo rje'i skur gyur te/ sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ shin tu khro zhing gtum la 'jigs ྃpa'i sku// zhal gdangs ljags 228) 'dril mche gtsigs spyan gsum bgrad/ smin ma ag tshom ral pa me ltar 'bar// phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs// g.yon pa thugs kar sdig mdzub phyag rgya gzir// zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang dor thabs bzhengs// dbu la thod skam rigs lnga dar dpyangs mdzes// snyan dang mgul dang phyag zhabs thams cad la// rin chen rgyan dang sbrul gyis chun bus brgyan// sku stong glang chen ko rlon smad stag sham// khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad rdzogs// ye shes me spungs 'bar ba'i klong na 'gyings// spyi bor om̐ dkar mgrin par ā dmar po// thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chung ngu'i steng*// rdo rje mthing ga nas tsam gyen du langs// de yi lte bar thugs srog sa bon ni// hūm̐ yig mthing nag phra zhing gsal bas mtshan// gnas gsum om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od zer ni// kha 229) dog sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pa yis// sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam lha// thams cad phyag na rdo rje'i cha lugs su// byon nas bdag la gnyis su med par thim// slar yang gnas gsum 'bru gsum 'od 'phros pas// rgyal ba rigs lnga la sogs dbang gi lha// 'khor 'das mdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas kyang*// rin chen bum pas bdag la dbang bskur zhing*// bdud rtsi bum chu tshangs bug nas babs te// lus nang gang zhing dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs thob// dbang lha thams cad mi skyod pa la thim// rigs kyi bdag polasangs rgyas mi skyod pa/

/rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma tha mi dad// spyi bo'i gtsug tu 'bral med bzhugs par gyur// de nas rang gi thugs ka'i rdo rje de'i// lte ba'i nang na hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du// rtsa ba'i sngags kyi yig 'bru mthing ga'i mdog g.yas su skor ba byed ltar 'khor zhing 'khyil// 230) de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim// gnod byed gza' klu gdug pa can rnams kyis kyang tshar bcad dbang du bsdus shing bka' nyan gyur/ skye 'gro thams cad phyag rdor skur gyur nas/ sngags kyis rang sgras stong khams gang bar gyur/ om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes rtsa ba'i snying po 'di nyid la rtse gcig tu 'bad de bzla zhing*/ ༈ thun mtshams 'jog pa'i skabs su/ bdag nyid lha'i sku dang thugs ka'i rdo rje sngags dang bcas pa thams cad thugs srog hūm̐ nyid las 'dus zhing thim/ hūm̐ yang nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar dngos med du gyur par bsam la/ rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug bcos slad med pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag la/ slar yang rang lus phyag rdor gyi rnam par lam me pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas/ bsod nams 'di yis gsang ba'i bdag po nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 231) 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog 1$10002501$1000180 ces dge ba bsngo bar bya'o/ de ltar 'di ni gsang bdag phyag rdor dregs pa kun 'dul gyi rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa rgyun khyer dbang du byas pa yin la/ gzhan sgrub pa dang las sbyor sogs byed na dmigs pa kha bsgyur dang*/ khyung sham 'dogs sogs gzhung nyid dang slob dpon gyi zhal rgyun sogs las zhib par shes dgos pa nyid do/ 'di ni gang zag gsar bu pa rnams la phan phyir don gnyer re zhig gis bskul ngor bris pa dge'o/
